name: long-context-compaction
description: After many turns of conversation the agent should still recall key facts from early turns — tests context compaction quality

turns.user_input: Important context: our API key rotation happens every 90 days, next rotation is May 15th. The responsible team is Platform Security, led by Janet.
Also note: we have a hard dependency on the Payments service v2.3. Any upgrade needs sign-off from both Platform Security and the Payments team lead, Marcus.
One more thing: our SLA for the checkout flow is 99.95% uptime, measured monthly. Last month we hit 99.92% due to a DNS issue.
Let's discuss something else entirely. Can you explain the difference between gRPC and REST?
Now back to our infrastructure. Who do I need sign-off from for a Payments service upgrade, and when is the next API key rotation?
